column1: # Partition table for the ESP32-S3-N16R8-EXT (16 MB flash).
# Offsets start at 0x11000 so the same table works whether the partition table
# lives at 0x8000 (default) or 0x10000 (Secure Boot needs the larger offset).
# factory is 3 MB to leave headroom for the LVGL/touch UI (+ signature/padding
# under Secure Boot + Flash Encryption); part0 is the pico-keys object store.
